remarks: Opportunity knocks for you to explore Fairfield County before you Buy!! - Now Available Until June 2027!!! Fully Furnished Rental at Palmer Landing!  Welcome Home to Palmer Landing, the premier, luxury, waterfront community on the Long Island Sound in Stamford. With direct water views, this beautifully furnished 3-bedroom, 3-bath end-unit townhouse feels like a private resort-this is waterfront living at its best. Wake up to breathtaking marina views, enjoy your morning coffee on 1 of 2 private decks, or unwind by the cozy fireplace as the boats drift by. The open-concept living space includes a large chef's kitchen with granite counters, hardwood floors, & stainless appliances, plus a dining area with dry bar and wine cooler-perfect for entertaining. The primary suite is a true retreat featuring your second private deck, perfect for enjoying a sunset glass of wine, plus a renovated walk-in closet & a spa-style bath with whirlpool tub, steam/sauna, stall shower, & vaulted ceilings. Private garage, & unlimited guest parking complete this fabulous unit. Minutes from downtown Stamford & Metro North, you'll have easy access to restaurants, shopping, & city life-then return home to peace & water views. Available Immediately until June 30, 2027 for any length of time. Fully furnished, just bring your suitcase. Ideal for a luxurious rental while completing your renovation or anyone looking for the ultimate rental.
